## GEOQuery

-   Get data from NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("GEOquery")
```

-   load library and helper libraries

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
library("GEOquery")
library("tidyverse")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download a GEO data

![](slide_images/mrna/Slide12.png){.absolute top="120" left="70" width="850"}

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
gse <- getGEO("GSE19187")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## GSE19187 Metadata

-   Get data from NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata <- pData(gse$GSE19187_series_matrix.txt.gz)
```

-   select relevant variables

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata <- metadata %>% 
  select("age:ch1", "disease state:ch1",
                "gender:ch1")
colnames(metadata) <- c("age", "disease", "sex")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Clean-up Metadata

<br>

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata <- metadata %>% 
  mutate(age = as.numeric(gsub(" y", "", age)))
```

<br> 

### summarise disease x sex

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata %>% 
  group_by(disease, sex) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = disease, values_from = n)
  
```


------------------------------------------------------------------------

## summarise disease x age

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata %>% 
  group_by(disease) %>% 
  summarise(avg_age = signif(mean(age), 0), 
            sd_age = signif(sd(age), 1)) %>% 
  mutate(age = paste0(avg_age, "±", sd_age)) %>% 
  select(disease, age) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = disease, values_from = age)
  
```


------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Table 1 summary

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
library(table1)

render_continuous <- function(x) {
  c(
    "",
    "Mean ± SD" = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

table1(
  ~ age + sex | disease,
  data = metadata,
  render.continuous = render_continuous
)
```
